description: This file defines a class LoraConstants that contains a collection of constant string values used throughout the LoRa adapter module. These constants include property names, field identifiers, content types, and other fixed values utilized in the LoRa adapter component of the Eclipse Hono project.

classes.name: LoraConstants
classes.description: A class encapsulating constant string values related to the LoRa adapter, used throughout the codebase for property keys, field names, and content types.
